query: SELECT DISTINCT ?institution ?institutionLabel ?person ?personLabel ?party ?partyLabel WHERE { VALUES ?class { wd:Q11204 wd:Q35798 wd:Q35749 wd:Q4358176 } ?institution wdt:P31/wdt:P279* ?class . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en,de". } FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?institutionLabel), "switzerland") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?institutionLabel), "schweiz")) OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:P463 ?institution . ?person wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q82955 . } OPTIONAL { ?person wdt:P102 ?party . } } LIMIT 100
